digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Friday, September 11 has 14 active timed calendar entries, 10 carried-over items, and five urgent priorities. The day turns on recovering Amazon Connect UAT from 32% completion toward today's 80% target, closing the routing, transfer, recording, and consent-prompt blockers, and making the direct-calling and Wave 1 scope decisions before the afternoon testing stack. Protect the open runway before 9:30 AM for those decisions and the executive update; the 3:00 PM triple overlap is the clearest schedule risk. Dashboard state was last modified Sunday, so completion status may be stale.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect UAT blockers
items.detail: Routing, warm and queue transfers, call unmute, recording and transcription, bilingual prompts, and the consent prompt remain under review. Assign owners and explicit retest criteria before today's working sessions.

items.label: Drive Amazon Connect UAT to today's 80% checkpoint
items.detail: Round II reached 32% completion last night, up from 12% but still well short of today's target. Track progress by group, recover missed tests, and escalate anything that threatens the checkpoint.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including permissions and monitoring, before UAT advances.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is needed.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested review and August-completions slide before the 3:00 PM executive status update block, which overlaps both UAT and the sprint review.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP, training path, and knowledge record
items.detail: Confirm the authoritative Contigo SOP, remaining approvals, and training path so the September 15 launch stays protected.

items.label: Clean up the PM operating view
items.detail: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet, then document how Toggl capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will guide staffing.

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
items.detail: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access and review Armando's application request in help desk ticket 0033237.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while next week's UAT and go-live work are arranged.

items.label: Clear Nicolas's time adjustment when it arrives
items.detail: Review the missed clock-in adjustment early so payroll follow-up does not linger.

items.label: Before 9:30 AM - Open decision runway
items.detail: Use the morning window to set the UAT escalation path, resolve Wave 1 questions, and advance the executive update before meetings begin.

items.label: 9:30-11:30 AM - Check-ins lead into a conflict
items.detail: Laura and Astrid 1:1s run back-to-back before SVC standup. At 11:00 AM, Group 1 UAT overlaps the Thiago 1:1, so choose coverage in advance.

items.label: Noon-1:30 PM - Training review and EOW checkpoint
items.detail: The go-live training and communications review overlaps protected blocked space at noon. EPMO's end-of-week check-in follows at 1:00 PM; use it for the consolidated program status.

items.label: 2:15-4:00 PM - UAT, pipeline, sprint, and executive work collide
items.detail: Group 4 UAT overlaps the 2:30 PM project pipeline sync. At 3:00 PM, Group 2 UAT, the Sprint 17 stakeholder review, and the executive slide update all run concurrently.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Two UAT groups run at once
items.detail: Groups 3 and 1 are scheduled concurrently. Delegate one stream and require a single blocker and completion readout before the day closes.

items.label: Finalize Amazon Connect direct-calling and Wave 1 scope
items.detail: Legal Leadership needs to confirm client-facing use, G-28 phone details, and any additional attorney roles. Separate required go-live behavior from post-launch enhancements and account for testing, training, documentation, and timeline impact.

items.label: Confirm the Contigo Plan IVR configuration
items.detail: Check the pilot's IVR requirements with Hilary and Jhara, then confirm whether the work belongs in the current Amazon Connect scope or needs a separate owner and timeline.

items.label: Mauricio Concha is out today
items.detail: Route decisions and follow-ups that normally depend on Mauricio around his absence.

items.label: Santiago is on vacation
items.detail: Santiago's calendar absence begins today and continues through next Friday.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Timecards and weekly setup
items.detail: Start with the scheduled timecard approval block so payroll and weekly planning are cleared before the meeting day.

items.label: 10:30 AM-1:00 PM - Standup with protected work time
items.detail: SVC standup is followed by an open hour and a noon blocked-space window, creating the best Monday focus stretch.

items.label: 2:00-5:00 PM - Portfolio and stakeholder sequence
items.detail: BD Portfolio Review at 2:00 PM leads into the Maria 1:1 at 3:00 PM and the Cory, Jorge, Jean, and Eugenia introduction at 4:30 PM. Eugenia and Santiago are scheduled out.
